en: Custom gRPC Server is now part of the DT Hub app. If you previously downloaded it separately, you can delete that folder, and in Preferences > Draw Things select "Use the server included in DT Hub".
it: Il Custom gRPC Server ora fa parte dell'app DT Hub. Se lo avevi scaricato a parte, puoi eliminare quella cartella e, in Preferenze > Draw Things, scegliere «Usa il server incluso in DT Hub».
